header.running_head: Learning, Teaching and Rehearsing the Knowledge of Deen and Questions that are Appropriate and those that are Inappropriate

blocks.text: soon come to know.' Hadhrat Umar (RA) therefore summoned them one day and called for me as well. I believe that he called them that day only to show me off to them. He said, 'What comments do you have about the (following) words of Allaah:

blocks.arabic_text: اِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ اللّٰهِ وَالْفَتْحُ ۝ وَرَاَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ فِىْ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ اَفْوَاجًا ۝ فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
blocks.text: (O Rasulullaah ﷺ!) When Allaah's help (to the Muslims) and victory come and you see people entering the Deen of Allaah in droves then glorify the praises of your Rabb (in gratitude for this great favour) and seek forgiveness from Him. Without doubt, He is the Greatest Acceptor of repentance.

Some said, "Allaah is commanding us to praise him and seek His forgiveness when His help arrives and when he grants us victory.' Others conceded that they were unable to comment and others remained silent. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said to me, 'O son of Abbaas! Do you share that view?' When I declared that I did not, he asked, 'Then what have you to say?' I replied, 'The Surah speaks of the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ that Allaah is informing him about. Allaah is saying to Rasulullaah ﷺ: 'When Allaah's help and victory, namely the Conquest of Makkah, come and you see people (entering the Deen of Allaah in droves), then this is an indication that your demise is imminent. At this stage, you should glorify the praises of your Rabb and seek forgiveness from Him. Without doubt, He is the Greatest Acceptor of repentance.' Hadhrat Umar (RA) then remarked, 'That is exactly what I understood.'" [^1]

Another narration quotes that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "Because Hadhrat Umar (RA) used to consult with me together with the senior Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) objected saying, 'Why do you consult him with us ..." The rest of the narration is like the one above. [^2]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) Discuss a Verse and an Incident with Hadhrat Ali (RA)
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that he once asked Hadhrat Umar (RA) about the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: يٰۤـاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تَسۡـــَٔلُوۡا عَنۡ اَشۡيَآءَ اِنۡ تُبۡدَ لَـكُمۡ تَسُؤۡكُمۡ
blocks.text: O you who have Imaan! Do not ask questions concerning those things that you will dislike when they are made known to you (because they are too difficult to carry out).

Sa'eed bin Mansoor, Ibn Sa'd, Abu Ya'la, Ibn Jareer, Ibn Mundhir, Tabraani, Ibn Mardway, Abu Nu'aym and Bayhaqi both in their Dalaa'il, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.1 Pg.276). Abu Nu'aym has also reported the narration in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.317)
Haakim (Vol.3 Pg.539), reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Dhahabi.
